result:
I’d make it much harder for people to stop seeing other people as people.

Not a world without disagreement—but one where disagreement doesn’t so quickly turn into contempt, and where the suffering of strangers feels as real as the suffering of those close to us. So many people become abstractions: enemies, statistics, outsiders.

If empathy became the default *before* judgment, I think our approaches to war, poverty, justice, and even everyday kindness would change profoundly.
